question: Can a knot interaction record a preparation history and thereby read the relative sign on two equally frequent old words?
primary_observable: Ordinary flip of one ready physical reader mark at the cut, full ordinary history and signed comparison for the same fixed word change.
forbidden_inputs: No signed preparation label or scoring convention in the ordinary data path. Preserve unavailable crosses, event failures, selection weights, physical violations and genuine memory effects.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Two orders using the same four permitted actions with writable, erased or randomly initialized memory, data-only and complete-word singletons.
first_executable_signal: Entire legal word action of the four declared holdings under both laws, followed by exact readout of the matched preparation protocols.
resource_budget: One numerical CPU, 4 GiB per process. All 11-bit fixture actions and the old four-step local switch, no population sampling and no expected long check.
stop_rule: First sign-sensitive record of independently derived provenance plus singleton test, a proof blocking the precise source/instrument class, or exhaustion of the frozen finite candidate.
decision_or_followup_rule: Distinguish written/signed controls, physical history records, mathematical phase transfer, weak discrimination, perfect calibration and occurrence of an identified new preparation. Referee pending.
